name: English - Intercultural Communication C1
description: This course, taught in English, should familiarize you with the principal theories of intercultural communication as well as providing a practical toolkit for approaching intercultural encounters through examination of critical incidents. You will also improve your ability to communicate effectively in a global context. We will view film clips, do simulations and hold discussions. Course enrolment is limited to 20 participants.
prerequisites: Ability to begin work at the C1 level of the GER as evidenced by your score on the placement test at www.moodle.tum.de (Please check current announcements as the exact percentages may vary each semester.)
